knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An element specification sets the outcome the item must reach on completion, which makes it checkable.
An acceptable element scores 1 and an unacceptable element scores 0. Room percentages are calculated from these scores later.
A measurable pass condition lets two auditors agree, and the recorded reason supports the corrective action.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes an outcome statement for one named element with a pass and a fail condition, and the assessor confirms each is measurable
Learner scores three sample elements as 1 or 0 against the written outcome, with all three scores agreed by the assessor
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written element statement signed by the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: An element statement cannot be checked by a second person
Scoring would expose a person to a hazard that the element itself creates
